# FbxTextureRemap fixture

This directory contains a **test-only** slice of the Abandoned House pack used by
`RawIron.Scene.FbxTextureRemapSmoke`.

- Purpose: prove FBX material texture remapping from author-machine absolute paths
  onto pack-local `Textures/` without requiring the full Wilderness Ruins PsxPack.
- Source pack: `Games/WildernessRuins/assets/PsxPack/World/Abandoned_House/`
  (same content family; keep attribution/license with that pack when shipping).
- Do not treat this fixture as a gameplay content substitute for PsxPack.
